name: Rain Game [SAINT REWORK]
desc:
Rain World fangame created on Roblox. Experience devastating rain and forage to survive in a harsh world.
The game is in a really raw state and in heavy progress. The map is currently being reworked.

Do note that your account needs to be 60 days old otherwise you'll get kicked. This is to slow down ban evasion via alts.
